launcher.observedGrammar: Bun cliPath + one internal43-char base64url launch-proof argument + original Node process.argv.slice(2), excluding caller-injected proof-prefix arguments
launcher.authority: Proof shape alone is not authenticated; retained original rootNode/process/image/actualargv -> actual Bun native parent chain plus fixed current script sources mandatory. No new HMAC verifier introduced.

publicPlan: Shared LaunchPlan currently starts exact Node bin/ocx.mjs start --port canonicalu16. Native original root argv captured suspended, not re-created from IPC inputs.
phase: Original Bun argv stays start even if it later creates a query while stopping. Child launch phase derives from the original owners capture timestamps; it must not require changing the original parent argv to stop.
service: Only same native generation in the original pre-stop listener set, obtained after typed Ready/current validation, is Service. Other directly proven Node->Bun launcher descendants remain Launcher/raw0. No arbitrary OtherRequired constructor added.
remainingHelpers: Full source/argv/call-site proofs for sentinel,OS console/priority/other helpers still require implementation/actual source-bound history; unknown helpers remain veto including raw0.
readonlyCommandContract: SCM query and Scheduler exact query remain the only diagnostic grammars; fixed source also contains sc qc but no acceptance expansion is made without required concrete argv/stage evidence and contract increment.
secrets: Internal launch-proof value is retained only as existing private native command data; no value copied to this source review, new logs, IPC reply or persisted authority.
